purpose: Teach: 降ら/好ま/つる/吐き/墨/艶/差し出し/お過ごし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日、雨、降らないね、傘いらない。
lines.en: No rain today, so no umbrella needed.
lines.style: Light, observational opening. Bright but not forced. Quick pace, natural rhythm of stating the obvious. Small pleased note underneath—the tiny relief of not needing gear.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。先生、長文、好まない、簡潔に書けって。
lines.en: Yeah. The teacher hates when we ramble—keeps telling us to write tight.
lines.style: Dry, knowing smirk underneath. Wry agreement that lands lightly. Pace settles into a shared understanding. Not quite laughing at the teacher, but close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 庭の朝顔、つる、棚に絡んでる。
lines.en: The morning glories in the garden are all tangled up the trellis.
lines.style: Animated, almost seeing it as she speaks. Slightly faster pace. Vivid without being precious. The energy of noticing something small and real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、走った後、息、吐きながら整える。
lines.en: After practice, I just stand there breathing out until my heart stops racing.
lines.style: Quieter, more internal. Slow pace. Sensing the moment—the physical fact of recovery. Not dramatic; just noticing his own breath. Grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 書道部、墨、たくさん使う。
lines.en: The calligraphy club goes through ink like you wouldn't believe.
lines.style: Easy, conversational. Slight shrug in the tone—a casual observation tossed out. Pace stays light. No particular weight, just reporting what she sees.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: Your shoes have a real shine to them.
lines.style: Steady, genuinely curious. Not a compliment-disguised-as-question, just noticing. Slight lilt upward on the observation. Soft, wondering tone underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩に、おにぎり、差し出したら、笑顔貰った。
lines.en: I handed a senpai some onigiri and got a smile back.
lines.style: Brightens noticeably. Simple satisfaction in the telling. Pace lightens. No elaboration needed—the exchange was small and real and that's enough.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おじいちゃんに、いかがお過ごしか、電話しよう。
lines.en: I should call my grandfather and see how he's doing.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. Tender underneath but not sentimental. Gentle decision-making, not obligation. The care sits quietly in his voice. Slight trailing-off suggests he's already reaching for the phone.
